     # default ignore list for detailed views
     IGNORE = ('module', 'docuri', 'version_added', 'short_description', 'now_date', 'plainexamples', 'returndocs', 'collection')
 
+    _TTY_MACRO = re.compile(r'(?<!\w)(?:([IBMUCRL])\(([^)]*)\)|HORIZONTALLINE\b)')
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tty_ify(cls, text):
+        def render(match):
+            macro = match.group(1)
+            if macro is None:
+                return '\n-------------\n'
+
+            value = match.group(2)
+            if macro in ('L', 'R'):
+                if ',' not in value:
+                    return match.group(0)
+                label, target = value.split(',', 1)
+                return '%s <%s>' % (label, target.strip()) if macro == 'L' else label
+            if macro in ('I', 'C'):
+                return '`%s\'' % value
+            if macro == 'B':
+                return '*%s*' % value
+            if macro == 'M':
+                return '[%s]' % value
+            return value
+
+        return cls._TTY_MACRO.sub(render, text)
+
     def __init__(self, args):
 
         super(DocCLI, self).__init__(args)

+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+import pytest
+
+from ansible.cli.doc import DocCLI
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('source, expected', [
+    ('L(text,URL)', 'text <URL>'),
+    ('L(text, URL)', 'text <URL>'),
+    ('R(text,ref)', 'text'),
+    ('R(text, ref)', 'text'),
+    ('HORIZONTALLINE', '\n-------------\n'),
+    ('IBM(International Business Machines)', 'IBM(International Business Machines)'),
+    ('plain M(name) B(text) C(value) R(text,ref) end',
+     "plain [name] *text* `value' text end"),
+    ('I(italic) B(bold) M(module) U(url) C(value)',
+     "`italic' *bold* [module] url `value'"),
+])
+def test_tty_ify(source, expected):
+    assert DocCLI.tty_ify(source) == expected
